pages.title: Fuel Cell
pages.text: Hydrogen on one side of a membrane, air on the other: the reaction that would burn them runs as a current instead.$(br2)Generates power.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Burns hydrogen (or ammonia) with oxygen for power, giving water. Set the load current and the fuel pressure. The voltage falls as the current rises, so the power peaks part-way (about 1 A/cm²). Too little current and the cell floods; too much and it starves.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (1 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Nitrogen, Water.
